
```{r build-supfig-series-numbers}
#| fig-asp: 0.618
#| out-width: "90%"
#| fig-width: 9
#| cache: false

obj <- build_supfig_timeseries_number(
    tar_read(
        population_variability_data,
        store = store_in_pipeline()
    ),
    tar_read(
        aggregate_survey_filtered,
        store = store_in_pipeline()
    ),
    tar_read(
        all_local_trends_outputs,
        store = store_in_pipeline()
    ) 
)

summaries_series <- obj$summaries

save_and_output(
    cowplot::ggdraw(obj$plot),
  filename = here_from_pipeline("output/Figure_S2.png"),
  bg = "white",
  width = 10,
  height = 0.618123 * 10,
  units = "in"
)
```
